name: Oni Isha
source:
Main character works in a large hospital with 22 females co-workers or patients. His distant uncle is the director of the hospital, so protagonist decides to act on his free will when personnel starts to criticize him. He searches for his next prey... 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-april-2002-duo-song-for-all.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公在一家大型医院工作，身边共有二十二名女性同事或患者。医院院长是他的远房叔父，因此，当其他员工开始批评他时，他决定随心所欲地采取行动，寻找下一个猎物……

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-april-2002-duo-song-for-all.html]vndbreview[/url]]
